decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Statement received 7/10/13, Design and Access Statement and Lighting Specification received 4/5/12, Amended plans: P-XB-30-260 received 17/7/12, Email confirmation received 15/8/12, perspective images received 15/8/12, Lighting calculation received 9/9/12. "Illumination of Wind Turbine: Ref 00558/A/P44 - Discharge of Condition Application", dated 21/09/12, received, 10/12/12.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The illumination hereby approved shall only be active between the hours of dusk until dawn.

Condition : 4 - The proposed lighting scheme shall be carried out at all time in accordance with the details outlined in the letter entitled "Illumination of Wind Turbine: Ref 00558/A/P44 - Discharge of Condition Application", dated 21/09/12, received, 10/12/12 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The luminance for the hereby approved development will have an average of 11.1 Lux unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
description: S73 application for the Removal of Condition 2 of planning permission 00558/A/P44 dated 22/10/2012 which was for the 'Illumination of a wind turbine from four light units around the base of the turbine, within the Sky Studios plant farm adjacent to the northern side of the building',as the lighting was installed and in operation since 12 December 2012
